subject: geom_smooth() and theme(legend.key()) conflict with color white

messages.author: 7fdcf2e6afd1a403
messages.subject: geom_smooth() and theme(legend.key()) conflict with color white
parts:
Dear Ggplot Community,

I came across the problem that the legend background reverts back to the ggplot default grey, if I define the background as white. It does not occur with other colors I tried out (black, blue (also the Hexa Code equivalents). I even tried using the whites (or slightly different shades of white) as a hexa code, but still had the key legend revert back to the ggplot default grey.
I would be grateful for any useful feedback here. I really need the key to have a white background for a book publication.
I have prepared a mini example that replicates the problem below.

Thanks in advance for your help.
Zsófia S. Ignácz

R version 3.4.0 (2017-04-21)
Platform: i386-w64-mingw32/i386 (32-bit)

#mtcars
#min(averages$av)
#install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
sessionInfo()
data(mpg)

p <- ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour=class))    + geom_point()
pblue<-p+theme(legend.key = element_rect(fill = "blue")) ### Legend key background defined as blue
pblue+geom_smooth()    ### Legend key background remains blue

pwhite<-p+theme(legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white")) ### Legend key background defined as blue
pwhite+geom_smooth()   ### Legend key background reverts back to ggplot defaults
pwhite+geom_smooth(show.legend = F) ### Problem solved!

pwhite<-p+theme(legend.key = element_rect(fill = "#FFFFFF")) ### Legend key background defined as blue
pwhite+geom_smooth()   ### Legend key background reverts back to ggplot defaults
pwhite+geom_smooth(show.legend = F) ### Problem solved!


But actually, I only want to display the smoothed curves data
p <- ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour=class))
pwhiteempty<-p+theme(legend.key = element_rect(fill = "#FFFFFF")) ###Empty graph defined
pwhiteempty+geom_smooth()        ###Legend key background ggplot default
pwhiteempty+geom_smooth(show.legend = F) ###This time previous hack doesn't work because this drops key legend (since there is no geom_point objects any longer, so it's logical)

blueempty<-p+theme(legend.key = element_rect(fill = "blue"))
blueempty+geom_smooth()         ###Legend key background remains blue
blueempty+geom_smooth(show.legend = F) ###Not relevant really, but does what it has to do.

messages.author: 74428f180627b7d7
messages.subject: Re: geom_smooth() and theme(legend.key()) conflict with color white
parts: A hacky solution, which creates a legend for geom_smooth without fill (because se = FALSE) and then overlays a geom_smooth with the se = TRUE but without the legend. I suspect that grey is underlying all the colours and it's only visible with white. Try it your problematic code with "orange" and you'll see it looks different to normal orange.
